## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 68 captures during March 2022. This provides the activity measure for the reporting period and indicates the volume submitted for review. The available activity information is limited to the recorded captures; no additional operational interpretation is included in this report.

## Image quality

There were 3 ungradable captures. The ungradable rate was 4.4 per cent. These results identify the portion of submitted images that could not be assessed to the required standard. The image quality measure should be considered alongside the overall capture activity when reviewing the site’s performance for March 2022.

## Grading

A total of 11 results were graded referable. The median lag from capture to grading was 16 days. This measure describes the central grading wait for the reporting period. Together, the referable results and median lag provide a summary of grading outcomes and timeliness at Oakridge Primary Care. No further grading detail is available in the information provided.
